SELECT sq_chat_message.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO chat_message (company_id, chat_message_id, chat_room_id, sender_employee_id, message_type, message_text, client_message_key, created_at) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{chatMessageId}, #{chatRoomId}, #{senderEmployeeId}, #{messageType}, #{messageText}, #{clientMessageKey}, default)
mapper.select: SELECT r.chat_room_id, r.room_type, CASE WHEN r.room_type = 'ROOM_DIRECT' THEN e.employee_name ELSE r.room_name END AS display_name FROM chat_room r JOIN chat_member m ON m.company_id = r.company_id AND m.chat_room_id = r.chat_room_id LEFT JOIN employee e ON r.room_type = 'ROOM_DIRECT' AND e.company_id = r.company_id AND e.employee_id = CASE WHEN r.direct_employee_low = m.employee_id THEN r.direct_employee_high ELSE r.direct_employee_low END WHERE m.company_id = #{companyId} AND m.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND m.left_at IS NULL
